description.narrative: IFC is considering a total funding package of US$100.0 million for Solar for Industries Limited, a subsidiary of LMI Holdings Limited (LMI), an existing client of the IFC. This includes an up to US$30 million IFC A Loan, up to US$40 million mobilized in B/Parallel loans, and an additional up to US$30 million subordinated loan from the IDA20 Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA PSW BFF). The funds will be used to develop and operate up to 150MW of solar power for industrial parks to be deployed in phases in Ghanas Tema Free Zones Enclave (Tema FZ) and Dawa Industrial Zone (Dawa IZ), in Ghana (the Project). The expected support from IDA20 PSW BFF is described further in the Blended Finance Section.

The Project will improve the affordability of electricity supply and reduce the greenhouse gas emissions associated with electricity generation in Tema FZ and Dawa IZ.
In terms of market creation, the Project is expected to contribute to creating a competitive power sector by demonstrating the feasibility of meeting commercial and industrial consumers electricity needs in Ghana through solar power. Additionally, it has the potential to enhance productivity and competitiveness for industrial zone tenants by providing reliable and green electricity.
